contribution_requirements: User asked to commit all changes to GitHub. Create a single commit per FEAT on the current branch (do not create a new branch unless explicitly requested). Commit message format: 'feat(ui): <short description>'.
key_patterns: 1. All color tokens go through tailwind.config.js — never raw hex in JSX except for Recharts `fill` props and the hardcoded `bg-[#F8FAFC]` chat bg. 2. Components use Tailwind utility classes directly (no CSS modules, no styled-components). 3. The Button component centralizes variant→color mapping; changing Button.jsx variants propagates to all consumers. 4. Badge.jsx similarly centralizes badge colors. 5. `primary-` classes = old blue brand (to be replaced with `brand-`). `teal-` classes = old client/chat accent (to be replaced with `accent-` in client portal, `brand-` in therapist portal sent-messages). 6. Semantic colors (emerald success, amber warning, rose danger) must NOT be changed.
